## PDF page 250

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/GTO/Poker-Math-Preflop-Workbook.pdf#page=250)

```text
                            CHAPTER TWENTY ONE



                     CHALLENGE MODE


The first rule of challenge mode is that you cannot participate until you have
completed this entire workbook. Hopefully, if you are reading this, you have
already done that. If so, congrats!

Challenge mode is an optional way of redoing this workbook in an effort to
improve retention and test your ability to apply concepts quickly. Since you
have limited time to act when playing real sessions, it is crucial that you can
think through complex problems at an accelerated rate.

Here are the rules of Challenge Mode:

   ●    Over the next three weeks you will complete one chapter per day
   ●    Spend no more than 20 minutes per day
   ●    You will not use any software, calculators, or tools
   ●    Estimate calculations
   ●    Take your best guess instead of skipping questions

By redoing the workbook this way you will continue to build a positive study
habit and improve your intuition. Most poker math is repetitive and patterns
quickly emerge when you do this kind of exploration. Just do your best and
you will see the steady improvement of your technical poker prowess in due
time.

GLGL.

                                     PA G E 2 5 0
```
